text:
incident-bot: Pager: P0 - prod inference API 5xx spike (>5% over baseline). Escalation: on-call @raj

deploy-bot: Deploy finished: release/db-migration-2026.03.17 -> prod (12:04 UTC). Canary split 30%.

emily: saw the pager — deploy finished ~1m ago. Canary showing 400/503s, several pods stuck in Init.

raj: i'm on it. grabbing logs and kubectl output.

danielle: migration job v12 is running; logs show it is waiting on a lock on schema_migrations and timing out repeatedly.

emily: kubectl output snapshot:```bash
NAME                                     READY   STATUS             RESTARTS   AGE
inference-api-2026-03-17-abcde           0/3     Init:CrashLoopBackOff  6          2m
inference-api-2026-03-17-fghij           1/3     Running             0          2m
migration-job-v12                        0/1     Running             3          3m
```

aaron: HPA autoscaled replicas 5 -> 25 because of error rate. Nodes under pressure, k8s started evicting non-guaranteed pods — some pods bounced and hit CrashLoopBackOff.

raj: immediate mitigation suggestions: 1) flip feature flag for new model route, 2) reduce canary traffic to 0, 3) pause the migration job.

emily: flipping feature flag now (`feature.use_new_models=false`) via console. Confirming traffic drop to release. :thumbsup:

danielle: trying to cancel migration job — controller refuses, it's stuck waiting on DB lock. Might need DB-side intervention or rollback of schema change.

aaron: starting rollback to previous image for inference-api. `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-api --to-revision=42`

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by aaron. Canary traffic set to 0%. Autoscaling suspension requested.

raj: observing metrics — 5xx are dropping, back to ~0.8% in the last 30s. Nodes stabilizing, new pods coming up healthy. Still a few CrashLoopBackOffs but they are decreasing.

incident-bot: Reminder: on-call handoff in 25m. Please update the incident channel and handoff notes for @emily.

customer-success: CS looped in. We have 5 customer reports of transient errors; CS team contacting them and collecting request IDs.

emily: quick customer impact assessment: 5xx peaked at ~7% for ~6 minutes during canary ramp; latency peaked to ~600ms. No data corruption detected. Post-rollback looks stable.

aaron: follow-up actions: decouple migration from rollout (run migrations separately with preflight locks), add a preflight DB-lock check in deploy pipeline, and add a kill-switch to pause auto-migrations on deploy. I'll start a patch.

raj: thanks team — marking incident mitigated. I'm staying on to help with postmortem draft. Passing handoff to emily for PM/CS coordination.

emily: noted. i'll open the incident doc with timestamps, impact, and action items.

(emoji reactions: :white_check_mark: from raj, :eyes: from danielle, :thumbsup: from customer-success)
